answer: Yarrow-bracket tournament bond: each epoch opens one single-elimination bracket. Every entrant locks 60 credits and stakes a distinct relic. A yarrow reading at the season nadir seeds the draw, so no artifact enters twice and rented relics fail the key check. Losers forfeit their bond; winners advance. 1,000 fake entrants need 1,000 relics plus 60,000 credits against a 40,000 pool; honest agents pay 60 once, keeping their relic.
